value.rationale: This is a complete natural metric ridge invariant of the established infinite stack-sorting simplex family, rather than a restatement of known volume or simplex facts. The 2/n exceptional fraction, nontrivial Pareto conditional scaling and failure of moment uniform integrability make the random-ridge angle statistic structurally informative, with a rare-event variance coefficient distinct from typical angles.
